verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only GitHub-based sign-in (OAuth, later a fine-grained GitHub App or local GitHub CLI auth), Cursor subscription sign-in, and per-organization API-key or subscription choices for agents. None of that is enterprise identity (SSO/SAML/OIDC) or cloud-platform authentication (e.g., Bedrock or Vertex) for compliance, so this applicable capability is unevidenced.
